newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.12 pct in Jan 24-Feb 21.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.12 pct in Jan 24-Feb 21.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.12 percent between January 24 and February 21, down from 0.24 percent in the previous four-week period, said a Fipe official.
Juarez Rizzieri, president of the Fipe institute, said a drop in school payments led to lower inflation in the period.
Education costs rose 1.97 percent, down from 4.33 percent in the previous four-week period, he said.
Rizzieri said he expects February inflation to be around 0.1 percent.
The president of the Fipe institute also announced the following breakdown of its weighted inflation index for the period:
- Food 0.52 pct rise in the period
- Housing 0.44 pct rise in the period
- Transportation 0.01 pct rise in the period
- Personal expenses 0.39 pct rise in the period
- Clothing -3.37 pct drop in the period
- Health care 0.29 pct rise in the period
- Education 1.97 pct rise in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures at weekly intervals.
